value.rationale: The symmetric-power representation and its dual form a canonical family of nonabelian Fourier character pairs, not an arbitrary finite slice. The exact sharp upper and lower L4/L2 constants and equality classification exhibit a discrete central-character resonance: at 3|n an unequal opposite-phase mixture strictly improves the pure-character lower bound, while aligned balanced amplitudes uniquely maximize. Both qualitative and quantitative phenomena persist through an infinite degree family and are not immediate from general Schur orthogonality alone.
